_about: Hydra-specific sentiment for a stratified sample of categorised mentions (see scripts/stratified_sample.py). Reads the post plus the context label so the model rates sentiment towards the thing Hydra refers to, not the whole post as Brandwatch does.

fields.prompt:
The "context" field says what "Hydra" refers to in this post (a product, organisation, place, game, person, idea, etc.). Judge the sentiment the author expresses towards THAT thing — not the overall tone of the post, and not the topic around it.

- "hydra_sentiment": one of:
  - "positive": the author likes, praises, recommends or is enthusiastic about it.
  - "negative": the author criticises, mocks, fears or condemns it.
  - "mixed": clearly both.
  - "neutral": it is only named, listed or reported on without the author's own evaluation (news reporting is usually neutral).
- "sentiment_reason": the evidence in at most 12 words, in English.

A villain or crime being described is not negative sentiment unless the author expresses a judgement. Never answer "unsure"; use "neutral" when there is no evaluation.
